parsed.main_gap: Lemma 4 incorrectly infers that the entire multigraph is acyclic from |E|<|V|.

errors.description: A graph with fewer edges than vertices may still contain a cyclic component plus isolated vertices. The repair is straightforward: |E|<|V| guarantees at least one component with fewer edges than vertices, hence a tree; use that component instead. Nothing requires it to contain vertex n.
errors.quote: Since $|E|<|V|$, the multigraph $G$ contains no cycle and no loop

parsed.notes: Apart from this local graph-theoretic error, the reduction, upper bound, and remaining lower-bound argument are coherent. Replacing the chosen component by any tree component completes the proof.
